scope: pilot; apply the same policy to Vanilla and Mutation-Guided

model.decoding_note: Use the Codex service default; the CLI does not expose a temperature override.

budget.candidate_unit: candidate files; each file may define exactly one top-level pytest test function
budget.attempt_policy: At most three launched calls total: one generation call and up to two retries only if the Codex process fails before capturing a structured response. A completed but invalid response is not repaired.
budget.token_usage_policy: Record service-reported usage when available. If unavailable, store null and report the limitation; do not make token-count claims. The call and eight-candidate caps remain binding.

validation.flakiness_rule: Reject a candidate if collection or any execution run fails, times out, or returns a non-zero exit code.
validation.correctness_rule: Retain only candidates whose asserted behavior is directly specified and has an independently documented correctness rationale. No reference implementation is used.
validation.base_suite_rule: Run the complete sanitized package base suite unchanged with each candidate.

data_policy.hidden_and_future_data: never supplied to generation or validation
data_policy.file_backup_errors: excluded pending A-side confirmation of legal visibility
data_policy.trajectory_provenance: Release snapshots are candidate frozen trajectories; A-side acceptance remains pending
